rule: Theorem application (first clause of the simplicity-collapse core), existential elimination, negation introduction
meaning: By the first clause of the verified simplicity-collapse core (SIMPLICITY-COLLAPSE-CORE), an act token performed at every world accessible from w and strictly efficacious for x leaves x not contingent at w. If one token strictly yielded every actual concrete being, it would strictly yield the node's witness, which is contingent. So a necessary sufficient cause of all actual concreta is excluded on the route; the route's root may still be necessary if its act is not both performed at every accessible world and strictly efficacious for each creature (#462, #555). Without the node the rival holds (one-world frame).
